title: Canva for church and ministry media
why: Sermon series graphics, event flyers and service slides shape how people experience your community, online and in the room.
what_is_different: Ministry media runs on weekly deadlines with volunteer teams. It needs series branding, scripture slides that are readable from the back row, and quick social versions of every announcement.

extra_modules.title: Readable scripture and lyric slides
extra_modules.outcome: You can: design slides people can read from the back
topics: safe areas for projectors and livestream
extra_modules.practice: Design scripture slides for a sermon

extra_modules.title: Sermon series packs
extra_modules.outcome: You can: create a full graphics pack for a series

starter_project: Create a sermon-series pack: title graphic, slides template, three social posts, a livestream thumbnail and an event flyer — shared as team templates for volunteers.
pitfalls: Using images or fonts without the right to use them
New design every week with no series consistency
